### Installing (read this first)

Trainer Lens isn't on the Play Store, so Android adds a few extra safety prompts. They're all expected:

1. **Download** the `.apk` above on your phone and open it. Allow your browser / file manager to *install unknown apps* if asked.
2. **Google Play Protect** may offer to scan the app. Tap **Install without scanning** (or let it scan — it won't find anything).
3. Open Trainer Lens and do the steps in order. Step 1 allows notifications. Step 2 allows **Display over other apps**: if Android says **Restricted setting**, tap OK, go back and do **step 3** (**Open App info** → **⋮ (three dots, top right)** → **Allow restricted settings**), then repeat step 2. *(The ⋮ entry only appears after step 2 has been blocked once.)* Step 4 (battery) is recommended.
4. **▶ Start session** asks to record the screen – choose **Entire screen**.
5. Switch to Pokémon GO. **Drag the 🔍 bubble** anywhere; tap it to open the window with the **IV** and **Bag** tabs. **Drag the bottom edge** of the window to resize it.
6. **Pictures and full guide:** [docs/WALKTHROUGH.md](https://github.com/PremKishore27/trainer-lens/blob/main/docs/WALKTHROUGH.md).
7. **Not sure where to go?** The window tells you: on the IV tab open a Pokémon from your list; on the Bag tab open Items (Poké Ball → Items).

**Updating:** install the new APK over the old one – your settings and permissions stay.
*Coming from a build before v0.2.4? Uninstall the old one once first (it used a different signing key).*

> Unofficial fan-made tool, not affiliated with Niantic, Scopely or The Pokémon Company. It only reads the screen and never taps or changes the game. Use at your own risk.
